title: द्विषष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 162 · Dawn: the sun rises on the fighting

summary.en: The warriors greet the sun at dawn and then fight on, with the field lit by fires and torches and filled with corpses and beasts of prey. Nakula faces Duryodhana's side in the fresh battle.
summary.kn: ಉದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವೀರರು ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಗೆ ನಮಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ರಣರಂಗ ಬೆಂಕಿ, ಪಂಜುಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳಗಿ ಶವ, ಮಾಂಸಭಕ್ಷಕ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದೆ. ನಕುಲ ಹೊಸ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಪಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भोर में योद्धा सूर्य को नमस्कार कर फिर लड़ते हैं, रणभूमि अग्नि और मशालों से प्रकाशित है और शवों तथा मांसभक्षी जीवों से भरी है। नकुल नई लड़ाई में दुर्योधन के पक्ष का सामना करता है।
summary.te: ఉదయం వీరులు సూర్యునికి నమస్కరించి మళ్లీ పోరాడతారు; రణభూమి అగ్నులు, కాగడాలతో వెలిగి శవాలు, మాంసభక్షక జీవులతో నిండి ఉంది. నకులుడు కొత్త యుద్ధంలో దుర్యోధనుని పక్షాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.
summary.ta: விடியலில் வீரர் சூரியனை வணங்கி மீண்டும் போரிடுகின்றனர்; களம் தீ, தீவட்டிகளால் ஒளிர்ந்து உடல்களாலும் ஊனுண்ணும் உயிர்களாலும் நிறைகிறது. நகுலன் புதிய போரில் துரியோதனனின் தரப்பை எதிர்க்கிறான்.
summary.ml: പ്രഭാതത്തിൽ യോദ്ധാക്കൾ സൂര്യനെ വണങ്ങി വീണ്ടും പൊരുതുന്നു; തീകളും പന്തങ്ങളും കൊണ്ട് പ്രകാശിതമായി, ശവങ്ങളും ഇരപിടിയന്മാരായ മൃഗങ്ങളും നിറഞ്ഞ രണഭൂമി. പുതിയ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ നകുലൻ ദുര്യോധനന്റെ പക്ഷത്തെ നേരിടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.162; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ते तथैव महाराज दंशिता रणमूर्धनि ।
संध्यागतं सहस्रांशुमादित्यमुपतस्थिरे ॥

meaning.en: Armored, O great king, at the head of the battle they all stood and worshiped the thousand-rayed sun as it came to the twilight of dawn.

verses.text:
उदिते तु सहस्रांशौ तप्तकाञ्चनसप्रभे ।
प्रकाशितेषु लोकेषु पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: When the thousand-rayed sun had risen, bright as molten gold, and the worlds were lit, the battle went on again.

verses.text:
द्वंद्वानि यानि तत्रासन्संसक्तानि पुरोदयात् ।
तान्येवाभ्युदिते सूर्ये समसज्जन्त भारत ॥

meaning.en: The duels that had been locked before sunrise were joined again once the sun was up, O Bharata.

verses.text:
रथैर्हया हयैर्नागाः पादाताश्चापि कुञ्जरैः ।
हया हयैः समाजग्मुः पादाताश्च पदातिभिः ।
संसक्ताश्च वियुक्ताश्च योधाः संन्यपतन्रणे ॥

meaning.en: Horses met chariots, elephants met horses, foot soldiers met elephants, horses met horses and foot soldiers met foot soldiers. Warriors, both locked together and apart, fell in the fight.

verses.text:
ते रात्रौ कृतकर्माणः श्रान्ताः सूर्यस्य तेजसा ।
क्षुत्पिपासापरीताङ्गा विसंज्ञा बहवोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Having fought through the night, wearied by the sun's heat, their bodies afflicted by hunger and thirst, many lost their senses.

verses.text:
शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानां कुञ्जराणां च गर्जताम् ।
विस्फारितविकृष्टानां कार्मुकाणां च कूजताम् ॥

meaning.en: There arose a noise, O king, touching the sky, O best of the Bharatas, of conches, drums and mridangas, of elephants trumpeting, and of bows being drawn and twanging,

verses.text:
शब्दः समभवद्राजन्दिविस्पृग्भरतर्षभ ।
द्रवतां च पदातीनां शस्त्राणां विनिपात्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: of foot soldiers running, of weapons falling,

verses.text:
हयानां हेषतां चैव रथानां च निवर्तताम् ।
क्रोशतां गर्जतां चैव तदासीत्तुमुलं महत् ॥

meaning.en: of horses neighing and chariots turning back, of shouting and roaring. It was a great tumult.

verses.text:
विवृद्धस्तुमुलः शब्दो द्यामगच्छन्महास्वनः ।
नानायुधनिकृत्तानां चेष्टतामातुरः स्वनः ॥

meaning.en: That swelling tumultuous sound rose to the sky, along with the piteous cries of men writhing, cut down by many weapons.

verses.text:
भूमावश्रूयत महांस्तदासीत्कृपणं महत् ।
पततां पतितानां च पत्त्यश्वरथहस्तिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: A great cry of pity was heard on the earth, from foot soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants falling and fallen.

verses.text:
तेषु सर्वेष्वनीकेषु व्यतिषक्तेष्वनेकशः ।
स्वे स्वाञ्जघ्नुः परे स्वांश्च स्वे परांश्च परान्परे ॥

meaning.en: In all those divisions, locked together many times over, men struck their own and others, and others struck their own and the enemy, and the enemy struck the enemy.

verses.text:
वीरबाहुविसृष्टाश्च योधेषु च गजेषु च ।
असयः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त वाससां नेजनेष्विव ॥

meaning.en: Swords loosed by the arms of heroes were seen among warriors and elephants like cloths being washed.

verses.text:
उद्यतप्रतिपिष्टानां खड्गानां वीरबाहुभिः ।
स एव शब्दस्तद्रूपो वाससां निज्यतामिव ॥

meaning.en: The sound of swords raised and struck down by heroes' arms was just like that, as of clothes being beaten clean.

verses.text:
अर्धासिभिस्तथा खड्गैस्तोमरैः सपरश्वधैः ।
निकृष्टयुद्धं संसक्तं महदासीत्सुदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: With half-swords, swords, tomaras and axes, a dreadful close fight with drawn weapons went on, great and savage.

verses.text:
गजाश्वकायप्रभवां नरदेहप्रवाहिनीम् ।
शस्त्रमत्स्यसुसंपूर्णां मांसशोणितकर्दमाम् ॥

meaning.en: The heroes made a river flow, born from the bodies of elephants and horses, carrying human bodies, full of fish that were weapons, muddy with flesh and blood,

verses.text:
आर्तनादस्वनवतीं पताकावस्त्रफेनिलाम् ।
नदीं प्रावर्तयन्वीराः परलोकप्रवाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: sounding with cries of pain, foaming with banners and cloths, a river leading to the other world.

verses.text:
शरशक्त्यर्दिताः क्लान्ता रात्रिमूढाल्पचेतसः ।
विष्टभ्य सर्वगात्राणि व्यतिष्ठन्गजवाजिनः ।
संशुष्कवदना वीराः शिरोभिश्चारुकुण्डलैः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants and horses, pained by arrows and spears, tired, dazed by the night and low in spirit, stood propping up all their limbs. Heroes with dry mouths lay with their heads, their lovely earrings still on.

verses.text:
युद्धोपकरणैश्चान्यैस्तत्र तत्र प्रकाशितैः ।
क्रव्यादसंघैराकीर्णं मृतैरर्धमृतैरपि ।
नासीद्रथपथस्तत्र सर्वमायोधनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: With various instruments of war lying revealed here and there, crowded with flocks of carrion-eaters, with the dead and half-dead, there was no path for chariots anywhere on the battlefield.

verses.text:
मज्जत्सु चक्रेषु रथान्सत्त्वमास्थाय वाजिनः ।
कथंचिदवहञ्श्रान्ता वेपमानाः शरार्दिताः ।
कुलसत्त्वबलोपेता वाजिनो वारणोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: When wheels sank, the horses, summoning courage, somehow drew the chariots, weary, trembling and pained by arrows. Those horses, of good breed and strength, were like elephants.

verses.text:
विह्वलं तत्समुद्भ्रान्तं सभयं भारतातुरम् ।
बलमासीत्तदा सर्वमृते द्रोणार्जुनावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: The whole army, Bharata, was bewildered, whirling, fearful and distressed, except for the two, Drona and Arjuna.

verses.text:
तावेवास्तां निलयनं तावार्तायनमेव च ।
तावेवान्ये समासाद्य जग्मुर्वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: Those two alone were a shelter and a refuge for the afflicted, while others, meeting them, went to Yama's abode.

verses.text:
आविग्नमभवत्सर्वं कौरवाणां महद्बलम् ।
पाञ्चालानां च संसक्तं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन ॥

meaning.en: The whole great army of the Kauravas was shaken, and nothing could be made out of the Panchalas, who were locked in the fight.

verses.text:
अन्तकाक्रीडसदृशे भीरूणां भयवर्धने ।
पृथिव्यां राजवंशानामुत्थिते महति क्षये ॥

meaning.en: In this great ruin of the royal houses of the earth, which rose like Death's playground and increased the fear of the timid,

verses.text:
न तत्र कर्णं न द्रोणं नार्जुनं न युधिष्ठिरम् ।
न भीमसेनं न यमौ न पाञ्चाल्यं न सात्यकिम् ॥

meaning.en: we saw neither Karna, nor Drona, nor Arjuna, nor Yudhishthira, nor Bhima, nor the twins, nor the Panchala, nor Satyaki,

verses.text:
न च दुःशासनं द्रौणिं न दुर्योधनसौबलौ ।
न कृपं मद्रराजं वा कृतवर्माणमेव च ॥

meaning.en: nor Duhshasana, nor Drona's son, nor Duryodhana, nor the son of Subala, nor Kripa, nor the king of Madra, nor Kritavarman,

verses.text:
न चान्यान्नैव चात्मानं न क्षितिं न दिशस्तथा ।
पश्याम राजन्संसक्तान्सैन्येन रजसावृतान् ॥

meaning.en: nor any others, nor ourselves, nor the earth, nor the directions, O king, as they were locked together, covered by the armies and the dust.

verses.text:
संभ्रान्ते तुमुले घोरे रजोमेघे समुत्थिते ।
द्वितीयामिव संप्राप्ताममन्यन्त निशां तदा ॥

meaning.en: In that bewildered and dreadful tumult, when a cloud of dust arose, they thought a second night had come.

verses.text:
न ज्ञायन्ते कौरवेया न पाञ्चाला न पाण्डवाः ।
न दिशो न दिवं नोर्वीं न समं विषमं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Kauravas, Panchalas and Pandavas could not be known apart, nor the directions, nor the sky, nor the earth, nor the level and uneven ground.

verses.text:
हस्तसंस्पर्शमापन्नान्परान्वाप्यथ वा स्वकान् ।
न्यपातयंस्तदा युद्धे नराः स्म विजयैषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Men eager for victory felled in that battle whomever they touched by hand, whether enemies or their own.

verses.text:
उद्धूतत्वात्तु रजसः प्रसेकाच्छोणितस्य च ।
प्रशशाम रजो भौमं शीघ्रत्वादनिलस्य च ॥

meaning.en: With the dust stirred up and wetted by blood, and with the wind's speed, the earthly dust died down.

verses.text:
तत्र नागा हया योधा रथिनोऽथ पदातयः ।
पारिजातवनानीव व्यरोचन्रुधिरोक्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: There elephants, horses, warriors, charioteers and foot soldiers, sprinkled with blood, shone like groves of coral trees.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनः कर्णो द्रोणो दुःशासनस्तथा ।
पाण्डवैः समसज्जन्त चतुर्भिश्चतुरो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, Karna, Drona and Duhshasana, four chariot-warriors, engaged four Pandavas.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनः सह भ्रात्रा यमाभ्यां समसज्जत ।
वृकोदरेण राधेयो भारद्वाजेन चार्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, with his brother, engaged the twins, Radha's son engaged Vrikodara, and Arjuna engaged Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
तद्घोरं महदाश्चर्यं सर्वे प्रैक्षन्समन्ततः ।
रथर्षभाणामुग्राणां संनिपातममानुषम् ॥

meaning.en: Everyone around watched that dreadful, great wonder, the superhuman clash of those fierce bulls among chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
रथमार्गैर्विचित्रैश्च विचित्ररथसंकुलम् ।
अपश्यन्रथिनो युद्धं विचित्रं चित्रयोधिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Teeming with strange chariots on strange courses, the charioteers saw a strange fight of men who fought in strange ways.

verses.text:
यतमानाः पराक्रान्ताः परस्परजिगीषवः ।
जीमूता इव घर्मान्ते शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: Striving, valiant, each wishing to conquer the other, they showered each other with arrows like clouds at the end of summer.

verses.text:
ते रथान्सूर्यसंकाशानास्थिताः पुरुषर्षभाः ।
अशोभन्त यथा मेघाः शारदाः समुपस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Mounted on their sun-bright chariots, those bulls among men shone like autumn clouds gathered.

verses.text:
स्पर्धिनस्ते महेष्वासाः कृतयत्ना धनुर्धराः ।
अभ्यगच्छंस्तथान्योन्यं मत्ता गजवृषा इव ॥

meaning.en: Rivals, great archers, striving archers, they closed with each other like rutting bull elephants.

verses.text:
न नूनं देहभेदोऽस्ति काले तस्मिन्समागते ।
यत्र सर्वे न युगपद्व्यशीर्यन्त महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Surely there is no breaking up of the body when its time comes, since all those great chariot-warriors did not fall apart at once.

verses.text:
बाहुभिश्चरणैश्छिन्नैः शिरोभिश्चारुकुण्डलैः ।
कार्मुकैर्विशिखैः प्रासैः खड्गैः परशुपट्टिशैः ॥

meaning.en: With severed arms and feet, with heads with lovely earrings, with bows, arrows, spears, swords, axes and pattishas,

verses.text:
नालीकक्षुरनाराचैर्नखरैः शक्तितोमरैः ।
अन्यैश्च विविधाकारैर्धौतैः प्रहरणोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: nalika arrows, kshurapras, narachas, claws, shaktis, tomaras, and other weapons of many kinds, polished and excellent,

verses.text:
चित्रैश्च विविधाकारैः शरीरावरणैरपि ।
विचित्रैश्च रथैर्भग्नैर्हतैश्च गजवाजिभिः ॥

meaning.en: with many-colored and many-shaped armor for the body, with broken and strange chariots, with dead elephants and horses,

verses.text:
शून्यैश्च नगराकारैर्हतयोधध्वजै रथैः ।
अमनुष्यैर्हयैस्त्रस्तैः कृष्यमाणैस्ततस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: with empty chariots like towns, their warriors and banners slain, with frightened horses without riders being dragged here and there,

verses.text:
वातायमानैरसकृद्धतवीरैरलंकृतैः ।
व्यजनैः कङ्कटैश्चैव ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः ॥

meaning.en: with fans fluttering again and again, adorned by slain heroes, with coats of mail and fallen banners,

verses.text:
छत्रैराभरणैर्वस्त्रैर्माल्यैश्च सुसुगन्धिभिः ।
हारैः किरीटैर्मुकुटैरुष्णीषैः किङ्किणीगणैः ॥

meaning.en: with umbrellas, ornaments, clothes and sweet-scented garlands, with necklaces, diadems, crowns, turbans and strings of bells,

verses.text:
उरस्यैर्मणिभिर्निष्कैश्चूडामणिभिरेव च ।
आसीदायोधनं तत्र नभस्तारागणैरिव ॥

meaning.en: with breast jewels, gems, gold medallions and crest jewels, the battlefield looked there like the sky with its host of stars.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनस्यासीन्नकुलेन समागमः ।
अमर्षितेन क्रुद्धस्य क्रुद्धेनामर्षितस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana met Nakula, each angry and impatient with the other.

verses.text:
अपसव्यं चकाराथ माद्रीपुत्रस्तवात्मजम् ।
किरञ्शरशतैर्हृष्टस्तत्र नादो महानभूत् ॥

meaning.en: The son of Madri, in good spirits, passed on your son's right side, scattering hundreds of arrows, and there was a great roar.

verses.text:
अपसव्यं कृतः संख्ये भ्रातृव्येनात्यमर्षिणा ।
सोऽमर्षितस्तमप्याजौ प्रतिचक्रेऽपसव्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Passed on the wrong side in battle by his cousin, Duryodhana, very impatient, did the same to Nakula in return.

verses.text:
ततः प्रतिचिकीर्षन्तमपसव्यं तु ते सुतम् ।
न्यवारयत तेजस्वी नकुलश्चित्रमार्गवित् ॥

meaning.en: Then the glorious Nakula, who knew how to fight in intricate ways, stopped your son as he sought to answer the slight.

verses.text:
सर्वतो विनिवार्यैनं शरजालेन पीडयन् ।
विमुखं नकुलश्चक्रे तत्सैन्याः समपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: Checking him from every side, and distressing him with a net of arrows, Nakula made him turn away, and his troops praised that.

verses.text:
तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति नकुलो बभाषे तनयं तव ।
संस्मृत्य सर्वदुःखानि तव दुर्मन्त्रितेन च ॥

meaning.en: Nakula said to your son, 'Stand, stand!' remembering all the sorrows caused by your ill counsel.
